description: Application bundle: read who signs each clinician's written applications, with the account ID and the access token. For each clinician whose applications we write: the signer's name, their email and mobile number with most characters hidden, where the signing stands (nothing to sign yet, waiting for the signer's contact, link sent, opened, signed, or what stopped it), and when the clinician confirmed the email or mobile is their own. Only the clinician signs, from their own phone or computer, after a one-time code.

access_token.description: The access_token payer_follow_up_request returned (shown once), or the token in an emailed link.

name: payer_follow_up_signers
title: Read who signs an application bundle's applications
